parts.text: Which claim correctly states what percent $Q$ is of $P$?

options.text: $Q$ is $20\%$ of $P$, because the percentage stays the same when the comparison is reversed.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem:
Vidya is told that mass $P$ is $20\%$ of mass $Q$.

She wants what percent $Q$ is of $P$.

part_answers.answer: If $P$ is $20\%$ of $Q$, then $P=0.2Q$, so $Q/P=5$ and $Q$ is $500\%$ of $P$. Subtracting from $100$ does not reverse the reference quantity.

teacher.key_rationale: Reversing the comparison makes P the new whole: Q/P = 5, so Q is 500% of P.
